messages:
maya: Quick sync — postmortem follow-ups from the delayed-usage incident. I compiled outstanding action items, need firm owners and dates.

oliver: thanks, can you paste the list here?

maya: pasted below — these are the items we agreed in the retro. please react with :white_check_mark: when you own one and add ETA.

```
A1) Reprocess 03/14-03/15 ingest batches with corrected token parser — owner: TBD — due: TBD
A2) Invoice correction pipeline: produce draft credit notes for affected accounts — owner: TBD — due: TBD
A3) Metering schema validation: add checksum + schema enforcement at ingest gate — owner: TBD — due: TBD
A4) Monitoring: create recurring anomaly query for token spikes and delayed batches — owner: TBD — due: TBD
A5) Postmortem doc update + stakeholder notify template — owner: TBD — due: TBD
```

arjun: I can take A1 (reprocess). ETA: end of next week (2026-03-31). Need a small compute slot to run backfill.

lina: I'll own A2 (invoice corrections). ETA: 2026-04-05 for draft credits. Need list of impacted accounts from arjun's run.

billing-bot: notice: batch_reprocess_job queued by arjun at 2026-03-24T09:12Z — job id: br-20260324-17

arjun: thanks bot. @lina I'll tag the job id in the credits sheet when results look sane.

oliver: I'll pick up A3 (schema validation) — ETA: 2026-03-28. Plan: add a fast checksum + reject-or-queue behavior, plus a metric we can alert on.

maya: awesome. @sre-ops can you own A4 (monitoring/anomaly query)? if not, suggest an owner.

sre-ops: we can take A4. ETA: 2026-03-27. Will add a dashboard and an alert to #incidents with a small severity threshold so we catch pattern regressions early.

maya: @oliver will you add the small alert rule to the rollout so we don't get noisy? keep threshold high initially.

oliver: yep — will stage as a canary rule and push to prod after 48h.

maya: A5 (postmortem doc + notify template) — I'll do that. ETA 2026-03-25 COB.

lina: question — for A2, do we apply credits automatically or send draft invoices for manual approval?

maya: finance preference = manual review for now. we do drafts and then a single bulk apply after review. saves us from accidental double credits.

arjun: blocker note: reprocess exposes a small variance in tokenization for <legacy_model_v1>. will surface diffs to the credits sheet.

oliver: if variance affects >1% of tokens for an account we should flag for manual review. agree?

lina: yes agreed. set that threshold in the credits sheet filter.

billing-bot: alert: delayed-ingest-window detected 2026-03-23T22:00Z — affected partitions: p3,p7. See /ops/backfill-run/br-20260324-17

maya: closing checklist: owners committed. next steps: arjun kick off backfill today, oliver deploy schema validation branch to staging, sre-ops create query, lina prepare invoice template, maya finalize postmortem doc. we'll reconvene 2026-04-01 for verification of applied credits.

lina: added ownership + ETAs to the shared sheet: https://redwood.example/sheets/finance-postmortem-2026-03

arjun: started job, progress 12% (reading from p3). will update here.

oliver: FYI I pushed a PR for checksum validation: https://git.redwood/eng/ingest/pulls/512 — reviewers: @oliver, @maya

maya: thanks everyone. small ask: if you hit unexpected scope, call it out in thread and we'll reassign. :pray:

sre-ops: noted. creating incident watch for 72h after credits applied.

billing-bot: update: br-20260324-17 progress 78% — no errors so far.

arjun: br-20260324-17 complete. results uploaded to /tmp/backfill-results/br-20260324-17.csv

lina: confirmed receipt, starting draft credit calc now.

maya: marking thread for follow-up — next sync 2026-04-01 10:00 PT.

```
Owners summary (quick):
- A1 reprocess: arjun — 2026-03-31
- A2 invoice corrections: lina — draft 2026-04-05
- A3 schema validation: oliver — 2026-03-28
- A4 monitoring/query: sre-ops — 2026-03-27
- A5 doc+notify: maya — 2026-03-25
```

maya: feel free to @mention me on any blockers. end.
